arguments.new_text:
def test_get_ignores_enoent(self):
        cache.set("foo", "bar")
        os.unlink(cache._key_to_file("foo"))
        # Returns the default instead of erroring.
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("foo", "baz"), "baz")

    def test_has_key_file_removed_before_open(self):
        cache.set("foo", "bar")
        original_open = open

        def open_after_removal(filename, mode):
            os.remove(filename)
            return original_open(filename, mode)

        # Simulate another process deleting the cache file just before open().
        with mock.patch("builtins.open", side_effect=open_after_removal):
            self.assertIs(cache.has_key("foo"), False)
